title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: Container Types, Trade Lanes and Refused Ports
content:
This reference belongs to Dangerous Goods Acceptance and lists, per category, the container types the hazardous goods may be packed in, the trade lanes on which the category is carried, and the ports of discharge at which it is refused. Container types are the codes printed on the booking; ports are five-letter UN/LOCODE codes.

## Lane names used below

The line runs eight trade lanes: Asia–North Europe, Asia–Mediterranean, Asia–Middle East–India, Intra-Asia, Transpacific Eastbound, Asia–US East Coast, Transatlantic Westbound, and Europe–South America East Coast.

## Values per category

| Category | Container types permitted | Lanes on which it is carried | Ports of discharge refused |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL DG Limited Quantity | 20DV, 40DV, 40HC, 45HC | all eight lanes | no port refused |
| AHL DG Class 9 Standard | 20DV, 40DV, 40HC, 20RF, 40RH | all eight lanes | no port refused |
| AHL DG Flammables and Corrosives | 20DV, 40DV, 40HC, 20TK | all eight lanes | no port refused |
| AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers | 20DV, 40DV, 20TK | all eight lanes | no port refused |
| AHL DG Compressed Gases | 20DV, 40DV | every lane other than Intra-Asia | HKHKG |
| AHL DG Special Approval | 20DV | Asia–North Europe, Asia–Mediterranean and Transatlantic Westbound only | SGSIN, HKHKG, AEJEA |

## Quick answers

- The codes 20RF and 40RH appear only in the AHL DG Class 9 Standard row; 20TK only for AHL DG Flammables and Corrosives and AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers.
- The 45HC type is listed for AHL DG Limited Quantity alone.
- AHL DG Special Approval is the narrowest row: a single container type, three lanes and three refused ports.
